title: 5-Day Migration Safari by Air: Arusha to the Northern Serengeti
overview: Skip the long road transfers and take a light aircraft from Arusha straight to the northern plains, where the herds gather at the Mara River between July and October. You stay in camps placed close to the crossing points, spend your days on guided game drives, and look for big cats among the wildebeest and zebra.
highlights: Scenic flight from Arusha to the northern Serengeti
Camps close to the Mara River crossings
Lion, leopard and cheetah on the herd routes
Most of your time spent on game drives, not on the road

itinerary.title: Arusha to Northern Serengeti
body: Your safari adventure begins with a hotel pickup in Arusha and a transfer to Arusha Airport for a one-hour flight to Kogatende Airstrip in Northern Serengeti. Upon arrival, your private safari vehicle will be ready for an exciting Northern Serengeti game drive, with a visit to the Mara River to witness the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration crossing.

From July to October, the Mara River in Northern Serengeti becomes the dramatic stage of the Great Migration. Wildebeest gather along the riverbanks before making the plunge, while crocodiles wait in the water and predators such as lions and hyenas patrol nearby.

You’ll spend time around Kogatende or Lamai, giving you a better opportunity to experience a river crossing when nature decides the moment is right. Between crossings, explore the quieter side of Northern Serengeti, where you may encounter lions on the kopjes, elephants in the Mara woodland, and fewer safari vehicles.

After an unforgettable day of wildlife and migration viewing, return to Safari Haven Migration Camp, a mobile migration camp ideally positioned in Northern Serengeti for the Mara River crossings, for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.
Acc: Moyo Migration camp

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive - Northern Serengeti
body: Wake up early for an unforgettable Northern Serengeti game drive, with the main goal of witnessing the spectacular Mara River crossings of the Great Wildebeest Migration. From July to October, thousands of wildebeest and zebras gather along the Mara River, creating one of Africa’s most dramatic wildlife experiences.

Explore the Kogatende and Lamai areas, where you may encounter large herds, lions, elephants, leopards, and other Serengeti wildlife. After an exciting day in the north, enjoy a scenic game drive toward Central Serengeti, arriving at your camp in the evening.
Day: 3 Full-Day Game Drive in Central Serengeti

Wake up in the heart of the Central Serengeti and enjoy a full day game drive through the legendary Seronera Valley, one of Tanzania’s premier wildlife viewing areas. Known for its year-round abundance of wildlife, Central Serengeti offers excellent opportunities to encounter lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest and other plains game across its stunning open savannah.

Start early to catch predators when they are most active, then continue exploring the Seronera River, rocky kopjes and acacia-dotted plains. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon Serengeti safari game drive, searching for big cats resting around the kopjes and leopards in the riverine areas.
As the day comes to an end, return to your accommodation for dinner and a relaxing evening surrounded by the atmosphere of the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
body: After breakfast, begin your journey from the Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater with an exciting transfer game drive through the beautiful Tanzanian wilderness. Enjoy approximately three hours of wildlife viewing along the way, with opportunities to spot zebras, wildebeest, giraffes, elephants and other wildlife.

Around 10:00 AM, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage landscape and one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations. The 260 km² crater floor is home to an extraordinary concentration of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, hippos, flamingos and the rare eastern black rhino.

Spend approximately five hours on a Ngorongoro Crater game drive, exploring the crater floor and its diverse habitats. Visit the soda lake, search for flamingos, explore the Lerai Forest and keep your eyes open for predators and large herds of plains game. After an unforgettable wildlife experience, ascend the crater and continue to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park Game Drive & Return to Arusha
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha for a scenic 90-minute drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most spectacular wildlife destinations. Known for its impressive elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and diverse landscapes, Tarangire offers an unforgettable Tanzania safari experience.

Enjoy a full-day game drive through the park’s baobab-studded savannah, seasonal swamps and the Tarangire River. During the dry season, the river becomes a vital water source, attracting large herds of elephants and other wildlife. Keep your eyes open for lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, antelopes and a remarkable variety of bird species.

Enjoy a hot picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your Tarangire safari game drive, making the most of the afternoon light and abundant wildlife. After an exciting day exploring Tarangire National Park, begin your drive back to Arusha, arriving in the late afternoon and marking the end of your safari adventure.

meta.Overnight: No overnight, Safari ends in Arusha

title: 7-Day Safari to the Mara River Crossings
overview: A full week built around the most dramatic moment of the migration, when thousands of animals plunge into the crocodile-filled Mara River. After the southern parks you move north with the herds and give the crossings enough time to be seen properly rather than squeezed into a single afternoon.
highlights: Several days in the north for the best chance of a crossing
Tarangire and Ngorongoro on the way
Guides who read the herds and the river
Lodge or camp nights, depending on your budget

itinerary.title: Arrival Kilimanjaro Airport to Arusha
body: Your Tanzania safari adventure begins the moment you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO). You’ll be warmly welcomed by your Lengai Trails representative, holding a personalized name board. From the airport, you’ll enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel in Arusha, nestled at the foothills of Mount Meru. Upon arrival, take time to relax, freshen up, and settle into your accommodation.

In the evening, enjoy a delicious dinner while meeting your safari guide, who will brief you on the exciting journey ahead and answer any questions about your Tanzania wildlife safari. After a restful night, you’ll be ready to begin your safari adventure.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha for a scenic drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations and renowned for its spectacular elephant herds and ancient baobab trees. Enjoy a full day Tarangire safari game drive through open savannah, seasonal swamps and the wildlife-rich Tarangire River. Especially during the dry season, the river attracts large concentrations of elephants and other wildlife. Keep your eyes open for lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, fringe-eared oryx, dwarf mongooses and an impressive variety of birdlife.

A delicious picnic lunch will be served in the park, allowing you to spend more time enjoying the wildlife and beautiful scenery. Continue your afternoon game drive before leaving Tarangire and heading to Karatu for a relaxing evening and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Cenral Serengeti National Park
body: After breakfast, travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the world-famous Serengeti National Park, enjoying wildlife viewing along the way. Enter Central Serengeti and explore the scenic Seronera Valley, renowned for year-round wildlife and exceptional big-cat sightings. Continue with a guided game drive across the endless Serengeti plains, searching for lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, and zebras. Arrive at Nakupenda Luxury Camp for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay in the heart of the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti & Mara River Great Migration
body: Travel north through the Serengeti on a scenic game drive toward the Mara River, the legendary stage of the Great Migration. Between July and October, the northern Serengeti offers exceptional opportunities to witness wildebeest and zebra gathering near the river and, when conditions align, dramatic river crossings.
Continue through Kogatende or Lamai, exploring the northern plains for lions, elephants, giraffes, and other wildlife before arriving at your intimate mobile camp near the river.
An optional sunrise hot air balloon safari is available at an additional cost.

meta.Overnight: Moyo Migration Camp In Northern Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Mara River Great Migration & Northern Serengeti Safari
body: Wake early for a sunrise game drive around the Mara River, one of the best areas to experience the Great Migration. From July to October, wildebeest and zebra gather along the riverbanks, creating unforgettable opportunities to witness dramatic river crossings. After lunch, begin a scenic game drive south through the Serengeti, enjoying wildlife sightings and the golden landscapes as you return to Central Serengeti.

meta.Overnight: Nakupenda Luxury Camp in Central Serengeti

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater Safari
body: After breakfast, enjoy a final Serengeti game drive as you journey toward the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable game drive, searching for lions, elephants, buffalo, hippos, hyenas, and the endangered black rhino.
Explore the crater floor with its rich wildlife and dramatic landscapes before ascending the crater rim and continuing to Karatu for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha – Hotel or Airport Drop-Off
body: After breakfast, depart Karatu and drive back to Arusha, enjoying the scenic countryside along the way. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have free time in Arusha before your transfer to your hotel, Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), or Arusha Airport (ARK) for your onward journey.

title: 3-Day Mara River Migration Trip from Zanzibar
overview: Three short days for beach travellers who want to see the migration without losing a week. You fly in from Zanzibar, spend your time with the herds near the Mara River and fly back to the coast, with the logistics handled for you.
highlights: Two nights close to the herds
Guided game drives in an open-roof 4x4
Easy add-on to a beach holiday

itinerary.title: Zanzibar to Northern Serengeti Mara River Crossing
body: Your 3 day Great Migration safari from Zanzibar begins with a hotel pickup and transfer to Zanzibar Airport for your flight to Northern Serengeti National Park. Upon arrival at Kogatende Airstrip around 11:00 AM, your private safari vehicle and professional Lengai Trails guide will be waiting for you. Begin your Northern Serengeti game drive as you head toward the Mara River, one of the most spectacular locations to witness the Great Wildebeest Migration. From July to October, thousands of wildebeest and zebras gather along the riverbanks before attempting the dramatic crossing, while crocodiles and predators wait nearby.

itinerary.title: Full Day Northern Serengeti Great Migration Safari
body: Rise early for a full day Northern Serengeti safari, with the main focus on the Mara River crossing and the Great Migration. Spend the day exploring the remote northern Serengeti, following wildlife movements and searching for opportunities to witness a river crossing. Northern Serengeti is not only famous for the migration. The region also offers exceptional wildlife viewing, including lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest and numerous bird species. Look out for magnificent birds such as ostriches, secretary birds and black eagles soaring above the savannah.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti & Fly Out to Zanzibar
body: Enjoy a final early morning game drive in Northern Serengeti, giving you one last opportunity to experience the wildlife and landscapes of the Serengeti. After the game drive, proceed to Kogatende Airstrip for your late morning flight back to Zanzibar. Upon arrival in Zanzibar, your 3 day Zanzibar to Serengeti fly in fly out safari comes to an end, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the Great Migration and the spectacular Mara River.

title: 8-Day Calving Season Safari, Midrange Comfort
overview: From January to March the southern plains fill with newborn wildebeest and the predators that follow them. This eight-day midrange itinerary pairs the calving grounds with Tarangire and the Ngorongoro Crater and keeps the pace relaxed, with comfortable lodges each night.
highlights: Newborn wildebeest and hunting cats near Ndutu
A full morning inside Ngorongoro Crater

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Kilimanjaro International Airport / Arusha Airport to Arusha

Your Tanzania safari begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK). Our Lengai Trails representative will meet you and transfer you to your hotel in Arusha. After check in, enjoy a relaxed evening at leisure and prepare for your safari adventure. Depending on your arrival time, your safari guide can provide a briefing about the journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Karatu
body: After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up around 8:00 am and drive approximately two hours to Tarangire National Park, famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and wildlife rich landscapes. Enjoy a full day game drive through the park’s savannah, seasonal swamps and the Tarangire River. Keep your eyes open for elephants, lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, elands, warthogs and an impressive variety of birdlife.
Enjoy a picnic lunch at Matete Picnic Site before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, drive to Karatu for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Central Serengeti
body: After an early breakfast, depart Karatu and travel through the scenic Ngorongoro Highlands toward Serengeti National Park. As you enter the Serengeti, the landscape opens into vast golden plains and wildlife rich savannah. Enjoy game viewing along the way before continuing into the Central Serengeti and Seronera Valley, one of Tanzania’s best areas for year round wildlife viewing. The region is renowned for its lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, zebras and large concentrations of wildebeest and other plains game.
Arrive at your tented camp for dinner and an evening surrounded by the sounds of the Serengeti wilderness.

itinerary.title: FULL DAY CENTRAL SERENGETI SAFARI
body: Spend a full day exploring Central Serengeti, with a particular focus on the Seronera Valley and its surrounding plains. Set out early when wildlife is most active and search for lions, cheetahs and leopards. The area’s rocky kopjes, acacia woodlands and riverine habitats provide excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. As the sun begins to set, return to camp for dinner and a relaxing evening beneath the African sky.

itinerary.title: CENTRAL SERENGETI TO NDUTU – GREAT MIGRATION CALVING SEASON
body: After breakfast, begin your journey toward Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti, the heart of the Great Migration calving season. From December through April, the short grass plains around Ndutu become an important gathering area for migrating wildebeest and other herbivores. The abundance of newborn calves also attracts predators, creating exceptional opportunities to witness lions, cheetahs and hyenas in action. Enjoy game viewing as you travel toward the Ndutu area before arriving at your mobile migration camp.

itinerary.title: FULL DAY NDUTU CALVING SEASON SAFARI
body: Explore Ndutu & Southern Serengeti
Today is dedicated entirely to the Great Migration calving season in Ndutu.

Set out early for a full-day game drive across the open plains, following the migrating herds and searching for newborn wildebeest calves. The concentration of young animals makes this one of the most fascinating periods for wildlife enthusiasts and photographers. The open grasslands also provide excellent opportunities to see predators such as lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other wildlife taking advantage of the abundance of prey. For an additional unforgettable experience, you may choose to enjoy a hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti plains, available at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Ndutu to Ngorongoro Crater & Karatu
body: Wake up early for a final morning game drive in Ndutu, then continue toward the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. Descend into the crater for an exciting game drive through one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations. The crater floor is home to large concentrations of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.
Enjoy a picnic lunch during your crater adventure before ascending the crater walls and continuing to Karatu.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha (Kilimanjaro International Airport / Arusha Airport)
body: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Arusha. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time to relax or explore Arusha before your transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK) for your onward flight.
Your 8-day Serengeti Great Migration safari comes to an end with unforgettable memories of Tanzania’s wildlife, landscapes and the spectacular calving season.

title: 4-Day Ndutu Calving Safari with Ngorongoro Crater
overview: A compact trip for the calving months. You spend time among the herds on the Ndutu plains, then descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a day with some of the densest wildlife in Tanzania. It suits travellers who want both highlights in under a week.
highlights: Calving herds on the Ndutu plains
A day in the Ngorongoro Crater
Short enough to fit into a long weekend away

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha & Optional Arusha City Tour
body: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK), you will be warmly welcomed by the Lengai Trails team and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. Depending on your arrival time, you can relax at the hotel or enjoy an optional Arusha city tour, visiting local markets, the Cultural Heritage Centre and the colourful Maasai Market. It is a great opportunity to experience local culture and purchase authentic Tanzanian crafts and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Ndutu to Southern Serengeti Calving Season
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha and travel towards Ndutu, passing through the scenic landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area before entering the Southern Serengeti ecosystem. During the December to April calving season, the Ndutu plains become one of the most spectacular wildlife areas in Tanzania. The nutrient rich short grass provides excellent grazing for the migrating wildebeest and zebras, while the concentration of newborn animals attracts numerous predators.

After arriving in the Ndutu area, enjoy an afternoon game drive through the calving plains, searching for wildebeest, zebra, gazelles, lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other wildlife. As the sun begins to set, continue to your camp for dinner and an overnight stay surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Full Day Ndutu Game Drive Serengeti Calving Season
body: Wake early for an unforgettable sunrise game drive in Ndutu, when the plains are at their most active. You may return to camp for breakfast before continuing your exploration, or choose a full day bush experience with packed breakfast and lunch.

Spend the day exploring the Ndutu calving grounds, where the Great Migration gathers during the calving season. Watch newborn wildebeest and zebra calves take their first steps while predators patrol the surrounding plains. With patience and a little luck, you may encounter lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators hunting across the open grasslands. The combination of abundant wildlife, dramatic predator activity and spectacular scenery makes Ndutu one of the most rewarding places to experience the Great Migration in Tanzania.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive & Return to Arusha
body: After an early breakfast, depart Ndutu and continue towards the Ngorongoro Crater. Descend into the crater for an extended game drive across its spectacular wildlife rich floor. The Ngorongoro Crater is one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations and offers excellent opportunities to see buffaloes, elephants, hippos, hyenas, zebras, wildebeest, lions and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.

Enjoy a picnic lunch while taking in the dramatic scenery before ascending the crater walls and beginning the journey back to Arusha. Arrive in Arusha in the evening, where you will be dropped off at your hotel or transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport for your onward journey.

title: 3-Day Calving Safari from Zanzibar by Air
overview: Fly from the Indian Ocean to the Serengeti plains, watch the calving season at close range and be back on the beach in three days. Light aircraft keep road time to a minimum, so nearly every hour is spent with wildlife.
highlights: Flights from Zanzibar to the Serengeti and back
Calving herds and the cats that hunt them

itinerary.title: Fly from Zanzibar to Serengeti & Game Drive
body: Your adventure begins with a hotel pickup in Zanzibar and transfer to the airport for your flight to Seronera Airstrip in the Serengeti. Upon arrival, meet your private Lengai Trails guide and begin your first game drive through the central Serengeti. You will gradually head south toward the Ndutu plains, following the migration route and watching for lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, giraffes, zebras and other wildlife along the way. The Seronera area is particularly famous for its year round wildlife and excellent big cat sightings.
Continue toward Ndutu for dinner and your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Full Day Wildebeest Calving Safari
body: Rise early for a full day of wildlife viewing across the Ndutu calving plains, the heart of the Great Migration during the calving season. From December to April, vast herds of wildebeest gather across the short-grass plains to give birth. Thousands of calves can be seen during this period, attracting lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators. Your experienced Lengai Trails guide will search the plains for dramatic wildlife encounters while also looking for resident species such as giraffes, zebras, gazelles and elephants. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the bush before continuing your afternoon game drive. As the sun begins to set, return to camp for dinner and a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Fly Back to Zanzibar
body: Start your final morning with an early game drive across the Ndutu and Serengeti plains. The early hours offer excellent opportunities to see predators returning from the night’s hunt and wildlife becoming active in the cool morning air. After the game drive, enjoy a picnic breakfast before continuing toward Seronera Airstrip for your scheduled flight back to Zanzibar. Upon arrival in Zanzibar, you will be met by your driver and transferred to your hotel, marking the end of your Lengai Trails Serengeti Calving Safari.

title: 6-Day Calving Season Route: Ndutu, Serengeti and Ngorongoro
overview: Six days that follow the herds across the southern Serengeti during the calving months. Time at Ndutu, the central plains and the crater gives you open grassland, kopjes and a caldera floor in a single, well-paced loop.
highlights: Central Serengeti kopjes and big cats

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport – Arusha

Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK), you will be warmly welcomed by the Lengai Trails team and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. Depending on your arrival time, you may enjoy an optional Arusha city tour, visiting local markets, the Maasai Market or Cultural Heritage Centre before settling into your accommodation. In the evening, relax at your hotel and meet your safari guide, who will brief you about the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Karatu
body: After breakfast, your Lengai Trails guide will pick you up at around 8:00 AM and drive to Tarangire National Park, one of northern Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations. Famous for its enormous elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and wildlife-rich Tarangire River, the park offers excellent opportunities to see elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, elands, warthogs, lions and numerous bird species. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the park before continuing with an afternoon game drive through the savannah and seasonal wetlands.
Later, leave Tarangire and continue toward the Karatu area for dinner and your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive to Southern Serengeti
body: After an early breakfast, depart for the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for game drive. The crater floor supports an extraordinary concentration of wildlife. Keep watch for lions, elephants, buffaloes, hippos, zebras, wildebeest, flamingos and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.

From December to March, the short-grass plains of Ndutu become the heart of the Great Migration calving season. Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest gather here to give birth, creating one of the most dramatic predator-prey spectacles in Africa.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drive in Southern Serengeti
body: Rise early for a full day of wildlife exploration in the Ndutu calving grounds, one of the best places in Tanzania to experience the Great Migration between December and March.
The morning game drive takes you across open short-grass plains, seasonal lakes and woodland areas where wildebeest, zebras and gazelles gather in large numbers.

This is an exceptional period for wildlife photography and predator sightings. Young wildebeest attract lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators, while large herds move across the plains in search of fresh grazing.
Enjoy a picnic lunch during the safari before continuing your afternoon game drive and returning to camp around sunset.
For an unforgettable perspective, you can also add an optional hot-air balloon safari over Ndutu, available at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Southern Serengeti to Karatu
body: After breakfast, enjoy your final morning game drive in the Ndutu and Southern Serengeti region. Continue searching for wildlife around the seasonal lakes, plains and woodland edges, with opportunities to see wildebeest, zebras, gazelles, giraffes and the predators that follow the migration.
After lunch, begin the scenic journey toward Karatu, a fertile highland town surrounded by coffee farms and located close to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.
Arrive at your lodge in the afternoon and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: LAKE EYASI CULTURAL EXPERIENCE & ARUSHA
body: Hadzabe & Datoga – Return to Arusha

After an early breakfast, depart for Lake Eyasi, a beautiful Rift Valley lake and home to the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. Visit the Hadzabe, one of Tanzania’s indigenous hunter-gatherer communities, and learn about their traditional lifestyle, relationship with nature and centuries-old cultural practices.

Continue to a Datoga community, renowned for traditional metalworking and blacksmithing. Observe their craftsmanship and learn more about their daily life and cultural traditions. After the cultural experience and lunch, begin your journey back to Arusha, arriving in the late afternoon or evening.
Your 6 day Tanzania calving safari concludes in Arusha, with an optional transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport depending on your onward travel arrangements.

title: 8-Day Safari: Lake Natron and the Mara River
overview: This route combines a remote, little-visited corner of the north, the salt lake of Natron beneath the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai, with the migration river crossings further west. It rewards travellers who want landscape variety as well as wildlife.
highlights: Lake Natron and its flamingo-fringed shores
Quiet corners away from the main circuit

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport to Arusha

Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK), you will be warmly welcomed by the Lengai Trails team and transferred to your accommodation in Arusha. Settle into your hotel and relax after your journey. Depending on your arrival time, you may have the opportunity to explore Arusha or simply enjoy a peaceful evening before your safari adventure begins.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Karatu
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha for Tarangire National Park, approximately a 2.5 hour drive away. Famous for its enormous elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and seasonal wetlands, Tarangire offers an excellent introduction to Tanzania’s wildlife. Enjoy a full day game drive through the park, searching for elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas and numerous bird species. During the dry season, wildlife gathers around the Tarangire River, creating excellent opportunities for game viewing. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the park before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, drive toward the Karatu area for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Lake Natron
body: After breakfast, continue toward the spectacular Lake Natron, travelling through the dramatic landscapes of Tanzania’s Great Rift Valley. Lake Natron is one of northern Tanzania’s most extraordinary destinations, known for its alkaline waters, volcanic surroundings and large concentrations of flamingos. The area lies beneath Ol Doinyo Lengai, Tanzania’s active volcano and one of the most distinctive mountains in the region. After lunch at your camp, explore the surroundings of Lake Natron and enjoy a nature walk toward the lake. Depending on seasonal conditions, you may see large numbers of flamingos gathering around the shallow waters.

itinerary.title: LAKE NATRON TO NORTHERN SERENGETI
body: Start the morning with an adventure around Lake Natron, including a guided hike toward the spectacular Ngare Sero Waterfalls. Surrounded by dramatic volcanic scenery, this is a refreshing contrast to the traditional game drive experience.
After lunch, begin the journey toward the Northern Serengeti, travelling through increasingly remote landscapes toward the Kogatende area.
Arrive in the Northern Serengeti and begin your first game drive around the Mara River ecosystem, where the Great Migration may be gathering during the July–October season.

itinerary.title: Full Day Great Migration Safari
body: Today is dedicated to one of Tanzania’s most spectacular wildlife experiences the Great Migration in Northern Serengeti. Set out early with your experienced Lengai Trails safari guide to search for the migrating wildebeest and zebra herds around the Mara River. Your guide will monitor wildlife activity and choose suitable areas for game viewing based on current conditions.

The river crossing is a completely natural event and cannot be guaranteed, but spending time in the Northern Serengeti during the migration season gives you an excellent opportunity to witness the herds gathering along the river.
Between migration sightings, continue exploring the surrounding plains and woodland, where you may encounter lions, leopards, elephants, giraffes, hyenas and other resident wildlife.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti To Central Serengeti
body: Rise early for another game drive in the Northern Serengeti before continuing south toward Central Serengeti and the Seronera Valley. The journey itself becomes a safari as you travel through changing landscapes and wildlife-rich plains. Keep your eyes open for elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest and big cats along the route.

Central Serengeti is famous for its year round wildlife and excellent opportunities to see lions, cheetahs and leopards around the Seronera River and surrounding kopjes. Enjoy an afternoon game drive before heading to your tented camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti Game Drive To Ndutu Plains
body: After breakfast, enjoy a final morning game drive through the Serengeti as you travel toward the Ndutu and Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Although the main wildebeest calving season occurs between approximately December and April, the Ndutu region remains an important wildlife area throughout the year, with resident wildlife and beautiful seasonal landscapes.
Continue through the southern Serengeti and Ngorongoro Conservation Area, enjoying game viewing along the way before arriving at your accommodation.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive to Arusha
body: After an early breakfast, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for your final major wildlife experience. The crater is one of Tanzania’s most famous wildlife destinations and provides excellent opportunities to see lions, elephants,buffaloes, hippos, zebras, wildebeest and, with some luck, the endangered black rhino.

Enjoy a game drive across the crater floor, including the open grasslands, Lerai Forest and the soda lake areas where wildlife gathers. After your crater experience, ascend the crater walls and begin the journey back to Arusha, where your 8 day Lake Natron and Great Migration safari comes to an end.
Depending on your onward travel plans, we can arrange a hotel drop-off or transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK).

title: 7-Day Calving Safari with a Lake Eyasi Cultural Visit
overview: Wildlife and people in one week. You follow the calving herds across Ndutu and the Serengeti, then spend a day around Lake Eyasi meeting communities who still live by hunting and gathering, led by local hosts.
highlights: Calving season on the Ndutu plains
A day with Hadzabe and Datoga communities at Lake Eyasi
Ngorongoro Crater on the way back

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Kilimanjaro International Airport & Arusha City Tour

Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), you will be warmly welcomed by the Lengai Trails team and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. After check in and some time to relax, enjoy a short guided city sightseeing experience before returning to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
Your safari briefing will be provided by your professional guide, giving you an opportunity to discuss the upcoming journey and prepare for the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Arusha To Tarangire National Park & Karatu
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha and drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s best destinations for elephant and wildlife viewing. Enter the park for a full day of game viewing among ancient baobab trees and the wildlife rich Tarangire River. Keep your eyes open for large elephant herds, lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffalo and an impressive variety of birdlife.
Enjoy a picnic lunch in the park before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, leave Tarangire and drive to the green highlands of Karatu for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Karatu To Southern Serengeti
body: After breakfast, drive towards Ndutu, the spectacular calving grounds of the Great Wildebeest Migration. From December to March, the short grass plains of Ndutu and the southern Serengeti become a major gathering area for wildebeest and zebra. The abundance of young animals also attracts predators such as lions, cheetahs, hyenas and leopards.

Enjoy a transfer game drive as you enter the migration area, followed by afternoon wildlife viewing across the Ndutu plains. Your guide will follow current wildlife activity and look for opportunities to observe the migration and predator action.

itinerary.title: Ndutu to Central Serengeti
body: Rise early and begin your journey towards the Central Serengeti and Seronera Valley, one of the most famous wildlife viewing areas in Tanzania. Enjoy a full day game drive through the Serengeti ecosystem, searching for lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, giraffes, buffalo, hippos and large herds of plains game.

A picnic lunch will be enjoyed in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. Your experienced Lengai Trails guide will select routes according to wildlife movements and current sightings.
Return to camp in the evening for dinner and relaxation beneath the Serengeti sky.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti to Ndutu
body: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic transfer game drive back towards Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti. Return to the short grass plains where the migration herds gather during the calving season. The area offers excellent opportunities to observe wildebeest, zebra and their young, together with the predators that follow the herds.
Spend the afternoon exploring Ndutu on a guided game drive before arriving at your intimate mobile camp.

itinerary.title: Ndutu to Ngorongoro Crater & Karatu
body: Enjoy an early breakfast before beginning your transfer game drive towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Descend into the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater for an extended game drive on the crater floor. The crater supports an extraordinary concentration of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffalo, hippos, hyenas and large herds of plains game. With luck, you may also encounter the endangered black rhinoceros.
After your crater experience, ascend the crater walls and continue to Karatu for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: LAKE EYASI CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
body: After an early breakfast, depart for Lake Eyasi, where you will experience a fascinating side of Tanzania beyond the traditional safari parks. Meet members of the Hadzabe community, one of Tanzania’s indigenous hunter gatherer societies. With the assistance of a local interpreter, learn about their traditional lifestyle, hunting techniques, gathering practices, bush knowledge and unique click based language. Continue to a Datoga community, known for pastoralism and traditional metalworking. Meet local artisans and learn about their blacksmithing traditions, beadwork and daily life.

After the cultural experience, begin the drive back to Arusha. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have some free time in Arusha before your transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your onward journey.

title: Mikumi Day Safari by Air from Zanzibar
overview: A same-day escape from the coast. You fly to Mikumi, spend the day on game drives across its floodplain, and fly back to Zanzibar in the evening, with a guide, vehicle and park fees organised in advance.
highlights: Full day of game drives in Mikumi
Back on the island by evening

itinerary.title: Zanzibar, Fly to Mikumi National Park, Full Day Game Drive& Fly Back to Zanzibar
body: Your Mikumi safari from Zanzibar begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel. You will be transferred to Zanzibar Airport for your scheduled flight to Mikumi National Park.

After landing, you will meet your professional safari guide and join the shared safari vehicle. Begin your full-day game drive through Mikumi National Park, exploring its open grasslands, woodland areas, and wildlife-rich plains.

Keep your eyes open for elephants, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, wildebeest, impalas, hippos, lions, and numerous bird species. Your guide will help you locate wildlife and provide information about the animals, landscape, and ecosystem.

Around midday, enjoy a local lunch in the park before continuing with your afternoon game drive. As the day comes to an end, you will drive back to the airstrip for your evening flight to Zanzibar. Upon arrival in Zanzibar, meet your transfer driver and enjoy a comfortable transfer back to your hotel.

title: Ngorongoro Crater Private Day Trip from Arusha
overview: One long day with a private vehicle and guide. You leave Arusha early, drive up to the rim and spend the morning on the crater floor before a picnic lunch beside the water and the road back in the afternoon.
highlights: Picnic lunch inside the conservation area
Back in Arusha for the evening

body: Arusha to Ngorongoro Crater & Back to Arusha

Your Ngorongoro Crater day trip from Arusha begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel. Drive towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, passing through the beautiful landscapes of northern Tanzania.

Upon arrival at the crater rim, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an exciting full day game drive. The crater floor is home to a remarkable variety of wildlife, and you may encounter lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos and many species of birds. The crater also offers one of Tanzania’s best opportunities to see the endangered black rhino. Enjoy a packed picnic lunch at a designated scenic location, surrounded by the spectacular crater landscape. In the late afternoon, ascend from the crater and begin the drive back to Arusha. You will be dropped off at your hotel or, depending on your travel arrangements, at Arusha Airport or another agreed location.

title: Tarangire Private Day Safari from Arusha
overview: Tarangire is close enough to Arusha for a single day and rich enough to feel worth it. Expect elephant herds, ancient baobabs and a picnic lunch under a tree, all in your own vehicle with a guide.

body: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Back to Arusha

Your 1 day Tarangire safari from Arusha begins with an early morning pickup from your hotel. Drive approximately 2 to 3 hours through scenic countryside toward Tarangire National Park. After entering the park, begin your game drive through the spectacular Tarangire ecosystem. The park is particularly famous for its impressive elephant population and giant baobab trees, while its varied habitats provide opportunities to see lions, giraffes, zebras, buffalo, wildebeests, antelopes, and numerous bird species. Around midday, enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic area inside the park before continuing with your wildlife exploration. In the afternoon, continue your Tarangire National Park game drive, taking time to search for wildlife and enjoy the park’s beautiful landscapes. Later, leave the park and drive back to Arusha, arriving in the early evening.

overview: A relaxed two-day trip with a night in a lodge near the park. You have an afternoon and a full morning on game drives in Mikumi, which is long enough to enjoy it without rushing, then fly back to the island.
highlights: Good value for a short break

itinerary.title: Zanzibar to Mikumi National Park
body: Your Mikumi safari from Zanzibar begins with a morning transfer from your hotel to the airport, followed by a scenic flight to Mikumi National Park. Enjoy aerial views of Tanzania’s changing landscapes as you leave Zanzibar behind and head toward the mainland.

Upon arrival at the Mikumi airstrip, meet your professional safari guide and begin your game drive through the park. Mikumi is known for its open grasslands, woodland areas, seasonal water sources, and diverse wildlife.
Keep your eyes open for elephants, lions, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, hippos, wildebeests, impalas and other wildlife, as well as numerous bird species.

Around midday, enjoy a freshly prepared picnic lunch in a designated area before continuing your game drive into the afternoon. As the day progresses, the warm African light creates beautiful opportunities for wildlife photography.
Later in the afternoon, leave the park and transfer to Double G Safari Camp for dinner and overnight accommodation.

itinerary.title: Full Day Mikumi Safari Fly Back to Zanzibar
body: Wake up to the peaceful sounds of the African bush and prepare for another exciting day in Mikumi National Park. After breakfast, continue your wildlife adventure with further game drives, exploring different areas of the park in search of animals and enjoying the spectacular scenery. Your guide will help you understand Mikumi’s wildlife, landscapes, and ecosystem while looking for memorable sightings. After your safari adventure, head to the airstrip for your afternoon flight, approximately 3:00 PM, back to Zanzibar. Upon arrival, meet your transfer driver and continue to your hotel.

title: 2-Day Tarangire and Crater Safari from Zanzibar
overview: For beach travellers with only two days to spare. You fly to Arusha, spend the day in Tarangire, sleep at a lodge and descend into the Ngorongoro Crater the next morning before flying back to Zanzibar.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Arusha Tarangire National Park – Ngorongoro
body: Your 2 day Tanzania safari from Zanzibar begins with a morning flight from Zanzibar to Arusha. Upon arrival, you will be warmly welcomed by the Lengai Trails team and receive a short safari briefing before beginning your journey to Tarangire National Park. Known as one of Tanzania’s best wildlife parks, Tarangire is famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees, seasonal wetlands, and beautiful open savannahs.

Enjoy a full day game drive through the park, searching for elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes, antelopes, and many other wildlife species. Your experienced safari guide will help you discover the park’s wildlife and explain the surrounding ecosystems.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater to Arusha & Zanzibar.
body: Wake up early and head to the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Tanzania’s most extraordinary wildlife destinations. Descend into the crater for an exciting game drive across its fertile floor, where a remarkable variety of wildlife can be found throughout the year. Look out for lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, hippos, wildebeest, hyenas, and other wildlife. With some luck, you may also have the opportunity to see the endangered black rhino.

After your crater game drive and lunch, begin the drive back toward Arusha. In the evening, transfer to the airport for your flight back to Zanzibar, bringing your memorable 2 day Tarangire and Ngorongoro safari from Zanzibar to an end.

title: 7-Day Northern Circuit Midrange Safari
overview: A classic first safari at a comfortable price. Tarangire, Lake Manyara, two nights in the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, driven in a private 4x4 and staying in mid-range lodges chosen for their location.
highlights: Four national parks in one week

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Your Tanzania safari adventure with Lengai Trails begins as soon as you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport. Our friendly Lengai Trails representative will meet you at the airport and transfer you to your accommodation in Arusha. After settling in, you can relax at the lodge or, depending on your arrival time, enjoy an optional Arusha city experience. Your safari guide will brief you about the exciting days ahead and make sure everything is ready for your journey through Tanzania’s Northern Circuit.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire national Park
body: After breakfast, your Lengai Trails guide will pick you up from your hotel around 7:45 AM and drive towards Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s best wildlife destinations. The journey takes approximately two hours before you enter the park and begin your first exciting game drive.

Tarangire is famous for its enormous elephant herds, ancient baobab trees, seasonal wetlands, open savannahs and the Tarangire River, which attracts wildlife throughout the year. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a scenic location inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park.
body: After breakfast, continue to Lake Manyara National Park, a beautiful and diverse wildlife destination located beneath the Great Rift Valley escarpment. Although relatively compact, Lake Manyara offers a remarkable variety of landscapes, including groundwater forests, open grasslands, acacia woodland, dramatic cliffs and the seasonal soda lake.

During your game drive, you may encounter elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes, hippos, baboons, monkeys and numerous bird species. The park is also known for its famous tree-climbing lions, although sightings are never guaranteed.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Serengeti National Park
body: After breakfast, your journey continues towards the world famous Serengeti National Park. As you travel through the Ngorongoro Highlands, enjoy spectacular scenery and, weather permitting, stop at the Ngorongoro Viewpoint for an unforgettable view over the magnificent crater. Continue towards Serengeti with a picnic lunch along the way. Once inside Serengeti National Park, the landscape changes dramatically into endless golden plains dotted with acacia trees and rocky kopjes.

Your afternoon game drive begins as you make your way towards the Seronera area, the central heart of Serengeti and one of Tanzania’s most productive wildlife viewing regions. Look out for lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes and many other species. As the sun begins to set, continue to your tented camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti Wildlife Safari
body: Today is dedicated entirely to exploring Serengeti National Park.
Rise early to take advantage of the best wildlife-viewing hours, when predators are often active and the morning light creates spectacular safari conditions.
The Seronera Valley is known for its permanent water sources, rocky kopjes, open plains and rich concentration of wildlife.

Spend the day searching for the Big Five – lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo and rhino, while also watching for cheetahs, hyenas, giraffes, hippos, zebras and the enormous herds of wildebeest and gazelles that make Serengeti famous.
Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive.
For an additional cost, you may also choose an unforgettable Serengeti hot air balloon safari, subject to availability.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
body: Ngorongoro Crater Safari

After breakfast, leave Serengeti and travel towards the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, one of Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife destinations. The journey itself provides opportunities for wildlife viewing as you leave the Serengeti plains behind.

Upon reaching the crater, descend into the crater floor for an unforgettable game drive. The crater’s enclosed ecosystem supports a remarkable concentration of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos, flamingos and, with some luck, the endangered black rhino.
Enjoy a picnic lunch while surrounded by the incredible scenery of this ancient volcanic caldera. After your crater safari, ascend the crater walls and continue to Karatu for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha
body: Enjoy your final breakfast in Tanzania before checking out around 11:00 AM. Your Lengai Trails guide will drive you back to Arusha, where you can be dropped off at your hotel or continue to Arusha Airport or Kilimanjaro International Airport for your onward flight. If your flight is later in the day, additional activities or an Arusha city experience can be arranged at an extra cost.

title: 7-Day Luxury Northern Circuit: Drive In, Fly Out
overview: A premium take on the Northern Circuit. You drive through Tarangire, Manyara and the Ngorongoro highlands to the Serengeti and then fly out from the Seronera airstrip, saving a full day of road travel at the end of the trip.
highlights: Scenic flight out of the Serengeti
Time to enjoy the properties, not just pass through

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN ARUSHA
body: Your Northern Tanzania safari begins with a warm welcome from the Lengai Trails team at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport. Our representative will meet you and transfer you to your luxury hotel in Arusha. Depending on your arrival time, you may enjoy an optional Arusha city tour, visit local markets or explore some of the city’s cultural attractions.

In the evening, you will receive a detailed safari briefing from your guide, giving you the opportunity to discuss the itinerary and prepare for the adventure ahead. For travelers arriving early, an optional visit to Kilima Moto can be arranged for a short hike and sunset experience overlooking the surrounding landscape.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park.
body: After breakfast, your private safari guide will pick you up at approximately 7:30 AM and begin the drive to Tarangire National Park, approximately two hours from Arusha. Tarangire is one of Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations and is particularly famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and diverse landscapes.

At lunchtime, stop at a scenic picnic area overlooking the Tarangire River. The river attracts wildlife throughout the day, creating excellent opportunities for photography and wildlife observation. After lunch, continue your afternoon game drive before exiting the park and driving to your accommodation.

itinerary.title: LAKE MANYARA & CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
body: Wildlife, Nature & Local Culture

After breakfast, enjoy the beautiful surroundings of your lodge before continuing your Lake Manyara safari experience. Today offers an opportunity to experience more than wildlife. Depending on your interests and timing, you can explore the local area around Lake Manyara and experience authentic Tanzanian culture.

Visit local farms and learn about banana and rice cultivation, meet members of local communities, and discover traditional crafts and everyday rural life. The combination of nature, culture and outdoor activities makes this a more relaxed and immersive day of your Tanzania safari holiday.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Safari
body: After breakfast, depart for the magnificent Ngorongoro Conservation Area and the world famous Ngorongoro Crater.

The crater is one of Tanzania’s most spectacular natural attractions. Descend into the caldera and begin your game drive across its wildlife-rich floor. The crater’s enclosed ecosystem provides excellent opportunities to see a wide variety of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos and numerous bird species. With luck, you may also encounter the endangered black rhino.
Enjoy a picnic lunch surrounded by breathtaking scenery before continuing your crater exploration. Later, ascend the crater walls and check in at your accommodation on the crater rim.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro to Serengeti National Park.
body: After breakfast, leave Ngorongoro and continue towards Serengeti National Park, one of Africa’s most famous wildlife destinations. The journey takes you through changing landscapes as the highlands give way to the vast plains of the Serengeti. Upon arrival in the Serengeti, continue with an afternoon game drive before heading to your accommodation.

As the afternoon cools, wildlife becomes increasingly active. Look out for lions resting near rocky kopjes, elephants moving across the plains, giraffes browsing acacia trees, zebras and wildebeest grazing, and possibly cheetahs or leopards. After your game drive, return to the lodge for dinner and a peaceful evening surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti national Park
body: Wake early for an exciting Serengeti sunrise game drive, one of the most memorable experiences of a Tanzania safari. The early morning offers excellent opportunities to observe predators while they are active and enjoy the beautiful golden light across the Serengeti plains. After the morning game drive, you can choose between a relaxed break at the lodge or continuing with a full day game drive.

Depending on the season and location, you may encounter lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, hyenas and many other species. Return to Kubu Kubu Tented Lodge in the evening for dinner and your final night in the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Serengeti morning Game Drive & Fly Out
body: Fly Out of Serengeti

Your final safari morning begins early with a sunrise game drive in Serengeti National Park. Travel with your luggage in the safari vehicle as you explore the plains one final time. The morning light provides excellent opportunities for wildlife photography and a final chance to encounter Serengeti’s iconic animals.

Later, continue towards Seronera Airstrip for your scheduled flight out of the Serengeti. Say goodbye to your Lengai Trails guide and board your flight for your onward journey, such as Zanzibar, Arusha or another destination, depending on your travel plans.

title: 6-Day Midrange Safari: Manyara, Serengeti and the Crater
overview: Six days that skip the busiest stops and spend more time where it counts. Lake Manyara, a long stretch in the Serengeti and a full crater day, in a private 4x4 with pop-up roof.

itinerary.title: Arrival In Arusha
body: Your 6 Day Tanzania safari begins with a warm welcome from the Lengai Trails team at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport. Our representative will meet you and transfer you to your hotel in Arusha, depending on your arrival time, you can enjoy an optional Arusha city experience, visiting local markets and cultural attractions before your safari begins.

In the evening, your safari guide will provide a detailed briefing about the journey ahead and answer any questions you may have. If time allows, you can also enjoy an optional short hike at Kilima Moto and experience the beautiful sunset over the surrounding landscape.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Lake Manyara Wildlife Safari
body: After breakfast at approximately 8:30 AM, depart Arusha and travel towards Lake Manyara National Park.Lake Manyara is a scenic and diverse park located at the base of the Great Rift Valley escarpment. The park is known for its beautiful groundwater forests, open plains, wildlife rich wetlands and seasonal soda lake.

Lake Manyara is also famous for its tree climbing lions, although sightings are unpredictable. You may also visit the hippo pool and, depending on conditions and park regulations, view the area’s natural hot springs, the park is an excellent destination for birdwatchers, with flamingos and many other bird species frequently seen around the lake.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Concervation Area to Serengeti.
body: After breakfast, depart from Mto wa Mbu and begin your scenic journey towards Serengeti National Park, the drive takes approximately six hours, including stops, and passes through the spectacular landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, along the way, there is an optional opportunity to visit a Maasai community and learn about traditional culture, crafts, livestock keeping and everyday life.

Upon entering the park, enjoy lunch before beginning an afternoon game drive around the Seronera Valley, the central area of Serengeti, enjoy the spectacular Serengeti sunset before heading to your camp for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to NgoroNgoro Highlands
body: Wake early for an exciting sunrise game drive in Serengeti National Park the early morning is an excellent time for wildlife viewing, when predators are often active and the soft morning light creates beautiful photography opportunities. After the game drive, return to camp for lunch and prepare for your journey towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.

Continue with a game drive as you leave the Serengeti, giving you another opportunity to view wildlife along the way, later, arrive at your accommodation near the Ngorongoro Crater rim and enjoy dinner with the anticipation of tomorrow’s crater adventure.
Day. 5: NgoroNgoro Crater to Arusha

Rise early for breakfast before descending into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater at approximately 6:15 AM, the crater is one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations. Its enclosed ecosystem supports a high concentration of wildlife and provides excellent opportunities for game viewing. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the crater before continuing your game drive, later ascend the crater walls and begin your journey back to Arusha.

body: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel before checking out At your preferred time, your Lengai Trails driver will transfer you to Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport for your onward flight.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha & Airport Transfer & City Tour
body: Your 6 day Tanzania safari begins with a warm welcome from the Lengai Trails team upon arrival at Arusha Airport. You will be transferred to your hotel, where you can relax after your journey. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy an optional city sightseeing experience in Arusha. Visit local markets, the Maasai Market, Cultural Heritage Centre, and Arusha City Museum to get an introduction to the culture, history, and everyday life of northern Tanzania.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park Safari
body: After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up from your hotel at approximately 7:30 AM. Meet your guide and fellow safari team before driving to Tarangire National Park, approximately two hours from Arusha.

Tarangire is famous for its spectacular baobab trees, diverse landscapes, and large elephant populations. During your game drive, keep your eyes open for elephants, lions, leopards, cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes, antelopes, and numerous bird species.

Around lunchtime, stop at a designated picnic site overlooking the Tarangire River. Enjoy your lunch while watching wildlife around the water. Monkeys and baboons are often nearby, adding to the fun of your safari experience.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Serengeti National Park
body: After an early breakfast, enjoy a short morning game drive in Tarangire before beginning your journey toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. The drive takes approximately six hours, including scenic stops, and passes through the spectacular Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, you will have an opportunity to stop at a viewpoint overlooking the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater and admire one of Tanzania’s most iconic landscapes.
Continue toward Serengeti and arrive in the late afternoon, depending on time and wildlife movements, enjoy an afternoon and evening game drive around the Seronera area in central Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Full Day Serengeti National Park Safari
body: After breakfast, head out on an exciting game drive through the western and central areas of the park, following current wildlife movements. Serengeti is renowned for its vast savannahs and extraordinary concentration of wildlife, making every game drive a new adventure.
Depending on the season and location of the animals, you may encounter large herds of wildebeest and zebras, elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, hippos, lions, cheetahs, leopards, and many other species.

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your game drive into the afternoon. Your experienced guide will use their knowledge of the park and recent wildlife sightings to maximize your opportunities for memorable encounters.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Highlands
body: After breakfast, depart Serengeti and drive toward the spectacular Ngorongoro Conservation Area, your journey takes you through changing landscapes as you approach the Ngorongoro , the world’s largest intact volcanic caldera. The crater is approximately 20 km wide and around 610 metres deep, creating a remarkable natural habitat for a wide variety of wildlife.
In the afternoon, arrive at your campsite overlooking the Ngorongoro area. Enjoy the cool highland atmosphere and spectacular surroundings before dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive Return to Arusha
body: Wake up early and descend into the Ngorongoro Crater at approximately 6:15 AM for your final wildlife adventure, the early morning is an excellent time for game viewing as wildlife is often active. Your guide will help you search for the elusive black rhino while exploring the crater floor. The crater’s unique enclosed ecosystem makes it possible to encounter a remarkable variety of wildlife within a relatively compact area. Look out for lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hyenas, hippos, gazelles, and numerous bird species.

Later in the afternoon, ascend the crater and begin your journey back to Arusha. Depending on your onward travel arrangements, you will be transferred to your hotel or Arusha Airport for your evening flight.

Visit the local markets, Maasai Market, Cultural Heritage Centre, and Arusha City Museum to discover traditional crafts, local products, and Tanzania’s cultural diversity, after your city exploration, return to your accommodation to relax and prepare for your upcoming safari adventure.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
body: After breakfast, depart Arusha for Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations. The park is particularly famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees, and diverse wildlife.

Enjoy a full day of game viewing across the park’s open savannahs and along the Tarangire River, an important water source for wildlife during the dry season. Look out for elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes, impalas, and, with luck, predators such as lions, leopards, and cheetahs. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic site before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, leave the park and transfer to your accommodation for dinner and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Serengeti National Park
body: After breakfast, begin your journey toward the world famous Serengeti National Park, travelling through the beautiful landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, stop at the Ngorongoro Crater viewpoint to admire the breathtaking scenery and take memorable photographs before continuing toward Serengeti.

Upon entering Serengeti National Park, enjoy a game drive along the way as you make your way toward the Seronera area. The central Serengeti is known for its abundant wildlife, including lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, and other savannah animals. Arrive at your campsite later in the day, enjoy dinner prepared by your safari chef, and spend the evening beneath the African night sky.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Serengeti National Park
body: Wake up early for an exciting morning game drive as the Serengeti awakens with the rising sun. Early mornings provide wonderful opportunities to observe wildlife when many animals are active.

Spend the day exploring different areas of the park, depending on wildlife movements and seasonal conditions. The Serengeti is famous for its large lion populations, leopards, cheetahs, hyenas, elephants, and vast herds of wildebeest and zebras.
Enjoy a picnic lunch during the day before continuing your afternoon game drive. Return to Seronera Campsite for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park to Ngorongoro Conservation Area
body: After breakfast, enjoy another wildlife adventure in Serengeti National Park. Explore the surrounding plains and wildlife-rich areas while searching for the animals you may not yet have encountered. The Serengeti’s diverse habitats support a remarkable range of wildlife, from grazing herbivores to powerful predators. Your route and game viewing opportunities will depend on current wildlife activity and the day’s conditions.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Safari Journey to Lake Eyasi
body: After an early breakfast, descend into the magnificent Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable game drive across its diverse habitats. This remarkable volcanic caldera supports a high concentration of wildlife, making it one of Tanzania’s most celebrated safari destinations.

Enjoy a picnic lunch in a designated area before continuing your wildlife exploration. Later, ascend the crater and travel toward Lake Eyasi, a scenic destination known for its cultural heritage and surrounding landscapes. Depending on arrival time and local conditions, you may have an opportunity to enjoy a relaxing canoeing experience around the lake as the sun sets.

itinerary.title: Lake Eyasi Cultural Experience (Hadzabe and Datoga Communities)
body: Begin your morning with a cultural excursion around Lake Eyasi, home to the Hadzabe hunter-gatherer community and the Datoga pastoralist and artisan community, with the assistance of a local guide and the communities’ permission, learn about the Hadzabe’s traditional hunting and gathering practices, their knowledge of the natural environment, and their traditional use of bows and arrows. You may also learn about local food gathering and daily cultural practices.

Continue with a visit to the Datoga community to discover traditional metalworking, beadwork, and aspects of their pastoral lifestyle. These encounters provide an opportunity to learn about Tanzania’s cultural diversity and the importance of preserving traditional knowledge.

itinerary.title: Materuni Waterfalls, Coffee Tour and Kikuletwa Hot Springs
body: After breakfast, depart for the foothills of Mount Kilimanjaro for a refreshing day of nature, culture, and relaxation, your first stop is Materuni Village, a traditional Chagga community surrounded by lush vegetation and beautiful mountain scenery. Enjoy a guided walk through the village and surrounding countryside before hiking to the impressive Materuni Waterfalls. Take in the peaceful forest atmosphere and admire the cascading water.

Continue with a traditional coffee experience, where local hosts introduce you to the process of preparing Tanzanian coffee, from the beans to the finished cup. Learn about local traditions and enjoy freshly prepared coffee.

Later, travel to Kikuletwa Hot Springs, also known as Chemka Hot Springs, a beautiful natural swimming spot surrounded by trees. Relax by the clear water, enjoy a refreshing swim if conditions permit, and take time to unwind after your safari adventures.

body: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel, depending on your departure schedule. At your preferred transfer time, our Lengai Trails team will arrange your transfer to the airport for your onward flight.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Lake Natron
body: Destination: Lake Natron

After breakfast, depart Arusha and travel north toward Lake Natron, following the spectacular Great Rift Valley Escarpment, the journey takes you through traditional Maasai country, with dramatic landscapes and views of Ol Doinyo Lengai, the sacred volcanic mountain known by the Maasai as the “Mountain of God.”

Arrive in the Lake Natron area and enjoy a guided walk toward the lake. Lake Natron is famous for its highly alkaline waters and is an important breeding area for lesser flamingos.Depending on conditions and your interests, you can also visit a nearby waterfall for a refreshing nature experience.

itinerary.title: Lake Natron to Northern Serengeti
body: After breakfast, leave Lake Natron and continue toward the remote Northern Serengeti.

The road climbs through the Rift Valley landscape before continuing toward Wasso and the northern Serengeti region. Enter Serengeti through the northern area and begin your first game drive. The Northern Serengeti is renowned for its spectacular wilderness, resident wildlife and, during the appropriate migration season, the movement of huge herds of wildebeest and zebra.

itinerary.title: Full Day Northern Serengeti Safari
body: This remote section of Serengeti offers a quieter safari experience, with rolling plains, rocky kopjes, river valleys and abundant wildlife, during the Great Migration season, the northern Serengeti can become a spectacular wildlife destination as wildebeest and zebra move through the region toward the Mara River.
Throughout the year, the area also supports resident wildlife including lions, elephants, leopards, buffaloes, giraffes, hippos, crocodiles and numerous antelope species.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti to Central Serengeti
body: After breakfast, begin your journey from Northern Serengeti toward the wildlife-rich Seronera Valley in Central Serengeti, enjoy game viewing along the way as you explore one of the most productive wildlife areas in Tanzania.

Seronera is particularly famous for its year round concentration of predators. You may encounter lions, cheetahs, leopards and hyenas, together with elephants, buffaloes, giraffes, hippos, impalas, topi, warthogs and zebras.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park to Ngorongoro Highlands
body: Enjoy a morning game drive in Serengeti before continuing toward the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, as you leave the Serengeti plains behind, your guide will share stories about the history, geology and wildlife of the region.

The Ngorongoro Conservation Area is one of Tanzania’s most remarkable landscapes, combining volcanic highlands, grasslands, forests and the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, arrive at your accommodation near the crater rim and enjoy breathtaking views over the surrounding landscape.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive & Lake Eyasi
body: After breakfast, descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable game drive, the crater’s permanent water sources support an impressive concentration of wildlife. During your game drive, look for lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas and, with some luck, the endangered black rhinoceros, enjoy a picnic lunch while surrounded by the dramatic scenery of the crater before ascending and continuing toward Lake Eyasi.

itinerary.title: Lake Eyasi Cultural Experience, Hadzabe & Datoga
body: Lake Eyasi is home to the Hadzabe and Datoga communities, whose traditional ways of life provide a fascinating cultural experience, with a local guide, visit the Hadzabe community and learn about their traditional hunting and gathering lifestyle. You may have the opportunity to observe traditional skills and learn about their close relationship with the surrounding environment.
Continue with a cultural visit to the Datoga community, known for their traditional pastoral lifestyle and metalworking skills, after the cultural experience, begin your drive back to Arusha.

itinerary.title: Materuni Waterfalls, Coffee Experience & Kikuletwa Hot Springs
body: Today, discover the natural and cultural attractions around the foothills of Mount Kilimanjaro, begin with a visit to Materuni Village, where you will take a scenic walk through lush landscapes to the impressive Materuni Waterfalls.

Continue to a local coffee farm and learn about the traditional process of growing, harvesting and preparing Tanzanian coffee, later, relax at Kikuletwa Hot Springs, a beautiful natural swimming spot surrounded by greenery. Enjoy time in the warm, clear water before returning to Arusha in the evening.

title: 3-Day Lake Natron and Ol Doinyo Lengai Trek (Shared)
overview: A tough, memorable trip for hikers. You travel to the Rift Valley, visit Lake Natron and its waterfalls, and make a night climb of the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Mountain of God.

itinerary.title: Arusha to & Lake Natron
body: Your adventure begins with an early morning departure from Arusha, followed by a scenic drive through the breathtaking landscapes of the Great Rift Valley toward Lake Natron. Along
the journey, enjoy views of traditional Maasai villages and keep an eye out for wildlife such as zebras, giraffes, and antelopes roaming the open plains.
Upon arrival at Lake Natron, check in to your accommodation and enjoy a delicious lunch while admiring the dramatic scenery of the lake and surrounding volcanic mountains.

In the afternoon, visit the beautiful Engare Sero Waterfalls, a hidden oasis surrounded by lush greenery. Take time to relax, swim in the cool natural pools, and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere before the trekking adventure begins.

Later in the evening, return to camp for dinner and a detailed briefing from your guide about the upcoming Oldoinyo Lengai climb. Prepare your equipment and rest early in readiness for the exciting trek ahead.

itinerary.title: Oldoinyo Lengai Summit Trek
body: Your trekking adventure begins shortly after midnight with an early ascent of Oldoinyo Lengai, allowing you to climb in the cooler hours before sunrise. The trek is steep and physically demanding, requiring good fitness and determination, but the experience is incredibly rewarding.

As dawn approaches, reach the summit in time to witness a spectacular sunrise over the Great Rift Valley, Lake Natron, and the surrounding landscapes. The golden morning light and panoramic views create an unforgettable moment at the “Mountain of God.”
Spend some time at the summit exploring the unique volcanic terrain and rare natrocarbonatite lava formations while capturing incredible photos of the dramatic scenery.
Later in the morning, begin your descent back to the camp. Although the descent can also be challenging, it offers beautiful changing views of the valley and surrounding wilderness.

Upon returning to camp, enjoy a well-deserved lunch and take time to relax and recover from the climb. In the evening, gather for dinner with your guides and fellow trekkers, celebrating the achievement and sharing memories from the day’s adventure.

itinerary.title: Cultural Experience & Return to Arusha
body: After breakfast, visit a traditional Maasai village and experience the rich culture and daily life of the Maasai people. Learn about their customs, traditions, and unique way of life while enjoying cultural activities such as traditional dances, songs, and local crafts. This cultural encounter offers a deeper connection to the people and heritage of northern Tanzania.

Later, return to camp for lunch and some time to relax while reflecting on the unforgettable experiences of the past few days — from the dramatic landscapes of Lake Natron to the challenging climb of Oldoinyo Lengai.
In the afternoon, begin the scenic drive back to Arusha, enjoying the final views of the Great Rift Valley and Tanzania’s breathtaking wilderness along the way.
Arrive in Arusha in the evening, where your 3-day adventure comes to an end, leaving you with lasting memories of culture, adventure, and extraordinary landscapes.
